targets.old_statement: Report lost or stolen plates to the local police, keep a copy of the complaint, inform the MVC, and replace them within 24 hours at an MVC Vehicle Center.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Report lost or stolen plates to the local police, keep a copy of the complaint, inform the MVC, and replace them within twenty-four hours at an MVC Vehicle Center.
